visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven final portable views against individually viewed local Green Park, Piccadilly arcade and Arlington entrance photographs, original floor plans/elevations and the 2021 condition survey. The open arcade, three mansard pavilions, five-bay end, lower entrance wing and rear court remain distinct. Review corrected roof continuity, chimney connections/positions, two-level pediment dormers and ground-floor window occlusion.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven final shared-material views, including the mapped footprint overlay, and full front/back/end views during correction. Limestone, granite, slate, membrane, copper and painted metal use metric shared bindings; glass is local. Flat terrain here is a material fixture; independent terrain remains in the portable scene.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail frames. Skyline preserves the arcade openings, three roof pavilions and chimney rhythm; district adds major windows and pediments; street and closeup restore mouldings and balcony detail. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Main mapped Ritz footprint, excluding William Kent House and the later 22 Arlington extension. Anchor [-0.14151513576507568,51.50700931620103], heading -2.4996485399285313: +X southwest along Piccadilly, +Z northwest toward the street. Independent Terrarium terrain remains unchanged, datum 18.8932 m at [0,24.8]. Foundation reaches -2.4 m. The map supplies no measured height; dated elevation and photographic proportions control approximate heights. Footprint suppression remains off; another host DEM can differ.

fidelityReview.scope: Dated historic main Ritz London exterior, Piccadilly arcade, Green Park end and Arlington entrance wing; William Kent House, later extension and interiors excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Individually inspected local 2015–2017 photographs, original ground and third-floor plans/elevations and the 2021 Purcell condition survey. Model represents the dated historic main hotel; subsequent roof and Arlington extension changes are explicitly outside scope. Upper court geometry, hidden service elevations, vertical dimensions and fine sculpture remain approximations. Original simplified balustrades, ironwork and canopy geometry do not copy photo pixels or the hotel crest.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets; exact triangle and byte counts are recorded in levels. Simplified mouldings and roof windows reduce distant detail while retaining the arcade and roof pavilion silhouettes. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured mesh deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; independent terrain PNG encoding error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi exterior of the historic main Ritz hotel, based on individually inspected local 2015–2017 photographs, original plans/elevations and Purcell 2021 condition survey. Later 22 Arlington extension and William Kent House are excluded.
Dated model scope does not claim to reproduce all current roof/construction changes. No temporary scaffolding, crowds, Christmas decorations or interiors.

Footprint is mapped; vertical dimensions, upper court geometry, rear windows, equipment and fine sculptural profiles are approximations. Main arcade remains open and rear court is not filled to full height.
Original simplified ironwork, stone balustrades and roof ornament; no copied photograph textures, hotel crest or exact lettering.
Independent terrain is unchanged. Deep foundation accommodates the rearward slope; exact contact can differ on another host DEM.
